The '''Kreeling system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kreeling/Legends|Kreeling]] where [[Moranda Savich]] managed to escape from [[Hal Horn]].
